summary: Tested volume tiers, the $16 priority surcharge, the Kitchener-Waterloo switch and the Pharmacy Batch Addendum, on the backend and in the UI. New suite tests/test_tiers_pharmacy_kw.py: 11/11 passed. It covers: /rate-card tiers and pharmacy block; re-rating on mer-1 through every tier (8.99 -> 7.49 -> 6.49 -> 5.99), with distance and the $16 priority charge added on top; paid invoices and invoices in an open Stripe checkout keep their price; a store with a custom base_fee keeps its flat fee; pharmacy import without a run or with a bad run returns 400; import with run=evening gives the stops manifest_id, batch_run, window 17:30-20:30 and tomorrow's date, and the fee counts 8 km included from the pickup address; manifest re-rating goes from 8.99 at 2 drops to 6.25 at 10 drops; one $28.25 platform invoice per month for mer-2, none for mer-1, and its PDF downloads; the admin pharmacy toggle checks access (401/403/404), rejects a bad address (400) and requires 'enabled' (422). Regression: I updated old tests from San Francisco to KW (phones +1415 -> +1519, Mission/SoMa/Sunset -> Downtown/Uptown/Westmount, SF addresses and coordinates -> KW, DEPOT and TZ constants -> KW/Toronto, base_fee 8 -> 8.99, compass North -> West in two dispatch tests because the KW seed has no North orders). Last full serial run: 375 passed, 27 failed, 1 xfailed. 8 of those 27 were stale tests that I fixed afterwards and reran green; the 2 dispatch tests fixed earlier were also rerun green. That leaves 20 open failures: 18 caused by the email provider rate limit (429 'email rate limit exceeded') and 2 caused by low-rating seed data. UI on a 375px mobile viewport: landing page tiers and pharmacy card are correct (Priority rush +$16.00). Books portal shows PICKUP RUN with run-afternoon and run-evening, upload without a run shows the toast 'PICK A PICKUP RUN FIRST', and upload works after picking evening. Bakery portal has no run picker. Admin Pricing > store rates sheet shows pharmacy-card, pharmacy-switch and pharmacy-pickup-input; turning the switch off and on works. The platform invoice shows in the Books invoices list. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: After a reset, mer-2 is reseeded as a pharmacy partner but its platform invoice is not recreated. ensure_platform_invoices only runs from platform_fee_watcher (every 600 s) or from PUT pharmacy. I reproduced this twice: right after a reset, db.invoices had 0 documents with kind=platform.

The KW reseed changed the random draws, so all 3 seeded 1-2 star ratings now fall more than 3 days back and are 'resolved'. The admin Low ratings 'open' list is empty on a fresh demo. Breaks test_low_ratings_badges.py::test_seed_has_open_low_ratings and the follow-on test.

Emergent email integration returns 429 'email rate limit exceeded'. This causes 18 failures in test_signup_review_requests.py, test_welcome_checklist_reminders.py and test_store_rates_bills_paid.py::test_weekly_email_send_now. It is an environment quota, not app code.

With the KW seed, the dispatch preview is North 0, South 2, East 6, West 10. Default coverage is drv-1 North, drv-2 South, drv-3 East, so the busiest zone (West) is uncovered and drv-1's zone is empty. Consider rebalancing the seed or the default coverage.

ui_bugs.issue: Toasts from the pharmacy card (bad pickup address error, 'PHARMACY CONTRACT ON/OFF') are drawn behind the RN <Modal> sheet, so the admin gets no visible feedback. The toast text is in the DOM, but the screenshot shows it covered.
Bad plural: '1 drops on this pickup'.

issues: The run date reads 'TOMORROW 26 MON'; 'TOMORROW · MON 26' reads better.
The CSV help text still lists window_date/window_start/window_end, but pharmacy runs silently overwrite them. Say so for pharmacy partners.
The upload success toast does not say which run or day the orders were booked into (after a cut-off they quietly go to tomorrow).
The Per-delivery fee, Km included and Per-km fields stay editable for a pharmacy partner, but get_pricing ignores those overrides. Disable or grey them out when the pharmacy contract is on.

action_items: Call ensure_platform_invoices() at the end of seed()/admin reset, so mer-2 always has its monthly $28.25 platform invoice right after a reset.
Seed at least one open (recent) 1-2 star low rating again, for example by forcing follow_up_status='open' on one recent low rating.
Make pharmacy-card toasts visible: render the toast inside the StoreRatesSheet Modal, or show an inline error or success line in PharmacyPartnerCard.
Fix the plural in run-<key>-drops ('1 drop').
Optional: disable the base_fee, included_km and per_km override inputs for pharmacy partners; show the booked run and day in the upload toast; rebalance the default compass coverage for the KW seed.
Email provider quota (429) is blocking 18 email tests. Rerun them once the quota resets.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is about 4600 lines; it should be split into modules (pricing/invoices, pharmacy, imports, dispatch).

apply_manifest_rate counts every stop in the manifest, including failed or undelivered ones, and never reverts invoices if stops are later removed. This is acceptable given the cut-off, but document it.
PharmacyPartnerCard sends pickup_address on every switch toggle, so each toggle triggers a Nominatim geocode (rate-limited to 1/s). Only send it when the address changed.
fix_import_row reuses the row's original manifest_id even after that run's pickup has passed. Edge case.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/*.py (KW migration of fixtures: phones, zones, addresses, coords, DEPOT/TZ, 8.99 base fee, compass West in test_auto_dispatch.py and test_bill_notes_balance_dispatch.py, customer_note_read added to PUBLIC keys in test_order_payload_trim.py)

success_rate.backend: 95% (383/403 effective; 100% of the new tier/pharmacy tests; remaining failures are 18 email 429s and 2 low-rating seed failures)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested flows; 2 minor UI bugs

seed_data_creation: Test stops, routes and payment sessions use the TEST_TIER prefix and are cleaned up. Final state is verified: pricing base_fee 8.99, included_km 5, per_km 1.25, priority_fee 16; mer-2 pharmacy_partner=true with pickup 385 Fairway Rd S, Kitchener; mer-1 is not a pharmacy and has no override; one mer-2 platform invoice for 2026-10 (re-created via PUT pharmacy after the last reset).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest serially (-n0) with /app/frontend/.env exported. test_tiers_pharmacy_kw.py marks the mer-1 tier test as skipped if mer-1 gets a custom base_fee. The 18 email failures are the provider's 429 quota. The KW seed puts no orders in compass North; dispatch tests now use West for drv-1.
